title: 2DMC
description: Makes Minecraft FEEL 2D! NOW IN BETA!
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/FX-ttYCFqOw" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

This plugin will make Minecraft feel 2D, but not in a way you would expect.
This plugin won't exactly blow your mind, but it still does the job well.
It all started with YouTube. 2D Minecraft videos that just cut the world flat. Then, a popular YouTuber named Mysticat came in and said, this IS NOT how you do it. And so, he made it with no mods(Plugin, resourcepack, and a custom map).

Hope you enjoy your 2D Minecraft experience!
This Mod is a WIP. 

Buy Mysticat's world, plugin and resourcepack on Patreon today:[Here](https://www.patreon.com/posts/mysticats-2d-74951952)
